newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on retail profit-taking after rising 4.7 percent in five days, brokers said.
The all share index closed 6.8 points down at 821.4. Blue chips John Keells Holdings fell 25 rupees to 335, Richard Pieris & Co nine to 126.

"The drop was due to profit-taking, mainly by retailers after the index gained 37 points in five days," said Gordon Nadesan of brokerge CT Smith. "But the downside is limited due to continuing buying interest."
Turnover was 72.6 million rupees, led by 26,000 shares of Development Finance, and 34,000 of John Keells Holdings.
